content:
nina (product): quick follow-up from the all-hands re: credits/quota behavior. dropping short Qs here.
samir (eng): customer saw 429s even though their monthly token usage was below quota. why?
julie (finance): two layers: monthly quota (billing units) vs short-term RPS caps. hitting RPS caps yields 429s even with remaining monthly credits.
ron (support): how do trial credits show up on invoices? customer asked.
julie (finance): trials appear as "promo_credits" lines and invoices are net after credits. CSV export includes credits_used column.
samir (eng): what about credit expiry? exact window?
julie (finance): promo/trial credits expire 180 days after grant unless moved to paid. enterprise grants per contract.
deploy-bot: deploy note: rate-limit header fix rolled out 11:12 UTC.
ron (support): SDKs sometimes mis-parse X-RateLimit-Reset. is there a recommended fallback?
samir (eng): rely on Retry-After when available; header was fixed to UTC epoch. docs will note advisory nature.
nina (product): pasteable support reply: `Rate limits (RPS) protect live serving and are enforced per-key; monthly quotas track units/credits and do not block short bursts unless RPS caps are hit; credits offset charges but expire per grant terms. For sustained production throughput use Dedicated or request quota increases through support.`
ron (support): perfect, will use that.
nina (product): actions: product to add composite quota view request; finance to update FAQ; support to get migration template. closing in 24h unless more Qs. :wave:
